queries.name: servidores_health_metadata_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name, USER_NAME() AS database_user

queries.name: servidores_health_metadata_tables
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND t.name IN ('Servidores_Conexiones','Servidores_ConexionEstado','Sistema_ServidoresConexionEstado','Sistema_ConfiguracionOperativa') ORDER BY t.name

queries.name: servidores_health_metadata_columns
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name, c.column_id, c.name AS column_name, ty.name AS type_name, c.max_length, c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND t.name IN ('Servidores_Conexiones','Servidores_ConexionEstado','Sistema_ServidoresConexionEstado','Sistema_ConfiguracionOperativa') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id
